battle.name: 杜彥冰起義
battle.brief: 大業九年（613）十一月，鄴城人杜彥冰與桑執行聚眾反隋，攻陷翼州、渤海郡一帶縣邑，眾至數萬；隋廷遣行軍總管韋世康率軍討之，跨年而定。卡面的科林斯青銅盔在隋代中國並無對應器物，隋軍備兜鍪明光鎧，義軍多備矛弓；真正與全罩青銅盔同一邏輯的，是兩邊都得靠隊形活命。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 杜彥冰起義是隋大業九年（613）十一月發生在河北鄴城與渤海郡一線的短期叛亂。交戰的一方是隋朝官軍：中央派出以行軍總管為統帥的討平軍，兵力以宿衛精騎與各郡郡兵為主；魏郡（治鄴城）、渤海郡（治浮陽，即冀州）一線的州府各有城防與守軍，但史籍同時記載郡縣官員遇賊多望風而潰，可見地方防線在起義面前已形同虛設。隋煬帝本人當時正在河北北巡，車駕九月至上谷、閏月幸博陵，河北沿線的郡縣正因巡行徵發而空虛。另一方是鄴城人杜彥冰與桑執行聚起的鄉里眾，兵眾記為數萬，成分是鄴城及周邊郡縣的鄉民、逃散兵卒與亡命者；兩部史書都沒有記下杜彥冰的僭號，這在同年起義者中相當特別。河北之外，同年冬天西北夏州一帶的稽胡貴族豆盧萼也舉兵反隋，眾至數萬，自稱大元帥，寇掠並汾；十一月，隋廷的注意力同時被山東、黎陽與江淮等地的戰火牽住。杜彥冰之舉因此不是孤立的民變，而是大業九年冬天全國性崩潰的一環。
countriesEn: The Du Yanbing rising was a short rebellion fought in November of the ninth year of the Daye era, 613, on the line between Ye city and Bohai Commandery in Hebei. One side was the Sui government force: a punitive expedition sent out from the centre under a supreme commander of the line, its strength drawn from the household guard cavalry and the county militia of the several commanderies. Wei Commandery, whose seat was Ye, Bohai Commandery, which governed the region known as Ji, and the other prefectures along that route each possessed walls and a garrison; yet the histories record at the same time that district officers lost heart and gave way at the first sign of the rebels, so that the local line of defence was already hollow when the rising came. The Sui emperor Yangdi was himself then on progress in northern Hebei: his carriage reached Shanggu in the ninth month and Boling in the intercalary month, and the districts along his route were emptied precisely because of that progress and the levies it demanded. The other side was the village band raised at Ye by Du Yanbing and Sang Zhixing, whose numbers are recorded as several tens of thousands and who were drawn from the country people of Ye and the neighbouring commanderies, from soldiers who had dissolved away and from men living outside the law. Neither history records any usurped title for Du Yanbing, which is a remarkable point among the rebels of that year. Outside Hebei, in the winter of the same year, the Jiehu chieftain of Xia Commandery in the north-west, Doulu'e, also raised troops against the Sui with tens of thousands of men, styled himself Great Marshal and harried the Bing and Fen districts. In November the court's attention was being pulled at once toward Shandong, toward Liyang and toward the river country south of the Yangtze. Du Yanbing's rising was therefore not an isolated disturbance of the countryside but one link in the general collapse of the year 613.
people: 杜彥冰是這場起義的首領，籍貫為鄴城，即魏郡治所，今河北臨漳一帶。關於他的家世、出身與首義經過，傳世文獻幾乎一無所存：《隋書》沒有為他立傳，《資治通鑑》只在編年記事中提到他的名字，連他起兵的地點與日子的細節都略去。與他一同起兵的桑執行同樣只有寥寥數筆，兩人在史書中都是一出現便被鎮壓下去的「賊帥」級人物。隋廷方面負責平定河北的是行軍總管韋世康；韋世康是京兆杜陵人，隋文帝時歷官尚書右僕射，煬帝即位後因疾去官，是年被起用赴河北，軍旅中的這一段是他一生最後的仕途。發動戰爭的決策者則是隋煬帝楊廣：起事消息傳到行在之後，他下詔討伐，同時在北巡途中發布改郡名、赦死罪、給復一年的詔令，用恩赦配合鎮壓。河北同年冬天還有另一支力量：十二月竇建德在漳南起兵，後自稱夏王、據樂安，與杜彥冰的眾遙相呼應；再往西，豆盧萼在夏州反叛，令隋廷同時在東、西、南三面用兵。杜彥冰本人沒有留下任何可供追考的個人事蹟，這本身就是這場戰爭最耐人尋味的地方。
peopleEn: Du Yanbing was the leader of this rising. His native place was Ye city, the seat of Wei Commandery, in the neighbourhood of present-day Linzhang in Hebei. Almost nothing survives about his family, his background and the course of his first rising: the Book of Sui gives him no biography, and the Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance mentions his name only in its annal, dropping even the detail of the place and the day on which he took up arms. Sang Zhixing, who rose with him, is likewise reduced to a few strokes, and in the histories both men appear as rebel commanders of the humbler sort, people who are put down as soon as they are named. On the Sui side the man charged with restoring order in Hebei was Wei Shikang, appointed supreme commander of the line. Wei Shikang was a native of Duling in the capital district of Jingzhao; under Emperor Wen he had risen to the office of Right Vice Minister of the Palace, and under Yangdi he had retired on grounds of illness, so that the year of 613 saw him called back into service for the Hebei command, the last campaign of his career. The decision to make war was the emperor's own: Yangdi Yang Guang issued the edict of condemnation once the news of the rising reached the imperial party, and along the route of his progress he at the same time promulgated edicts renaming commanderies, pardoning crimes punishable by death and remitting a year of levies, pairing conciliation with repression. In that same winter Hebei held another force: in December Dou Jiande rose at Zhangnan, later styling himself King of Xia and holding Luan, and he called across the distance to Du Yanbing's band; further west, Doulu'e rebelled in Xia Commandery, so that the Sui court was fighting on three fronts at once, east, west and south. Du Yanbing himself left behind no personal history that can be traced, and that is in itself the most striking thing about this war.
kits: 卡面這件科林斯青銅盔，是公元前六世紀後半期希臘城邦的產物：整副青銅面甲只留兩道眼孔與一道鼻樑，全正面罩覆，視野被壓到最低。它的價值與代價是同一件事——看得見的代價是，戴它的人只能靠隊形活；正面不留孔隙，士兵無法獨自判斷敵我與方向，必須踩著號令、貼著同伴前進。這套邏輯在隋代中國並無對應器物：隋軍的頭部防護是兜鍪，軀幹是明光兩當甲，視野比全罩面盔開闊得多，也不必靠鄰兵的視線行動；真正呼應青銅盔原理的，是隋軍步卒在野戰中結成的長槊方陣，密集的長兵器一列列推過去，前排的任務就是把後排的視線擋住，讓整個方陣像一具身體那樣運作。起義一方無從挑剔：鄉里起眾多自備長矛、弓箭、叉與扁擔繩索，能披皮甲、布甲者已算上乘，攻城器械史無一字記載。河北鄴城自漢以來即銅鐵冶煉與漳水漕運的中心，民間熟悉鍛冶之事，這是起義軍能迅速取得金屬器械的客觀條件，但杜彥冰軍中究竟有多少自備兵刃，正史沒有留下數目。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Corinthian helmet, a product of the Greek city-states in the second half of the sixth century BC: a full bronze face-piece with only two eye-slits and a nose ridge, closing over the whole face and pressing the field of view down to its lowest limit. Its value and its cost are the same thing. The visible cost is that the man who wears it can only live by his formation: with no opening in front, a soldier cannot judge friend from foe or direction on his own, and must move on the word of command pressed against the shoulder of the man beside him. There is no counterpart to this logic in Sui China. The Sui soldier guarded his head with a doumou helmet and his torso with bright scale and lamellar armour, a far wider field of view than a fully closed face-piece demanded, and he was not obliged to act on his neighbour's sight. What genuinely answers the principle of the bronze helmet is the long-spear formation that Sui infantry formed in the field: rank upon rank of long weapons pressed forward, the work of the front rank being to block the sight of the rank behind, so that the whole formation works like a single body. The rebel side cannot be faulted on such grounds: the village bands largely equipped themselves with long spears, bows, forks, poles and rope, and those who could get a leather or cloth coat were already in the better case, while siege equipment is not mentioned in the record at all. Ye in Hebei had been a centre of copper and iron smelting and of transport on the Zhang river since Han times, and the countryside was familiar with metalworking; that was the objective condition which let the insurgents obtain metal-edged tools quickly, but the official histories preserve no figure for how many weapons of their own Du Yanbing's men carried.
tactics: 關於這場戰役的戰術，兩部史書各留十幾個字，可據以推斷的空間有限。起義方是「聚眾數萬、陷翼州、渤海郡」：鄴城是魏郡治所，鄴、翼、冀三地相隔不過數百里，郡縣城多為夯土城牆，城防空虛，守軍士氣低落，起義眾以鄉里結社的散兵四面出擊，逐縣奪取州縣治所，這種打法在缺少攻城器械時最為有效。官軍一方能倚靠的是兩樣東西：一是宿衛精騎的快速奔襲，隋廷在山東靠張須陀以郡兵倍道進擊、在河內靠費青奴一衝解圍，都是用騎兵打擊叛軍的集結點，打完即走，並不打算正面攻城；二是各州府的城防與糧道，只求把叛軍擠出城池、封住糧道、困在冰封的野外，等其自行潰散。冬季的河北是這一打法的重要條件：漳水、滄水封凍，冰面可以通行人馬，但承載有限，重裝備與大批糧秣仍須靠陸路與河運，補給線一旦被切斷，數萬人的隊伍在嚴冬中數日之內就會散架。起義眾正是利用了這一點；隋廷的處置則是把討平與改郡名、赦死罪、給復一年綁在一起，用恩赦換取河北沿線在北巡期間的安靜。
tacticsEn: As for the tactics of this campaign, each of the two histories preserves a dozen-odd characters and the room for inference is narrow. The rebel side is recorded as gathering tens of thousands and seizing Wing Prefecture, Bohai Commandery. Ye was the seat of Wei Commandery, and Ye, Wing and Ji lay within a few hundred li of one another; the walls of the district cities were rammed earth, the garrisons were thin, and the morale of the defenders low, so that the insurgents, fighting in village bands, struck out in four directions and took one district seat after another. That method is the one that works best when siege equipment is scarce. The government's side could rely on two things. First, the rapid dash of the household guard cavalry: the court in Shandong relied on Zhang Xutuo advancing by forced marches with the county militia, and at Henei on Fei Qingnu breaking the siege in a single charge, both times striking at the point where the rebels massed and then leaving again without any intention of taking a city by assault. Second, the walls of the prefectures and the grain roads: the object was to squeeze the rebels out of the towns, close the supply lines and hold them in the frozen open country until they dissolved of their own accord. A winter Hebei was the condition that made this work: the Zhang and Cang rivers froze over, the ice would carry men and horses, but the load it would bear was limited, and heavy equipment and bulk grain still had to go by road and by river. Once the line of supply was cut, a force of tens of thousands could fall apart within days in the severity of the cold. That was precisely what the insurgents counted on. The court's response tied suppression together with the renaming of commanderies, the pardon of crimes punishable by death and a year's remission of levies, buying quiet along the Hebei route while the imperial progress continued.
data: 可核對的數字不多，但每個都有出處。大業九年即613年，起事在十一月，這是《隋書·煬帝紀》與《資治通鑑》所共的時點。起義眾的規模只有一個數字：數萬；所取的地方記作翼州、渤海郡兩處州郡治所，具體縣名不詳。官軍投入的兵力沒有留下數目，只知主官的職銜是行軍總管，討伐跨過了年關。距離可以按唐代里制粗略折算：自鄴城至渤海郡治浮陽（今河北滄州一帶）約六百里上下，至東都洛陽約四百五十里；這條線正是隋煬帝北巡博陵往返所走的舊路，也是河北糧運與兵員調動的主軸。同一年的河北與山東還留下多組可供對照的數字：清河張金稱眾數萬，渤海格謙與山東孫宣雅各眾十萬，山東王薄、孟讓眾十餘萬；十一月，右候衛將軍馮孝慈討張金稱於清河敗死，說明地方能戰之兵確實有限。事件本身沒有留下戰損、行程日數與攻城器械的數字，寧可留白，不宜補造。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are few, but each of them has a source. The ninth year of Daye is 613, and the rising falls in the eleventh month, a date on which the Book of Sui, Annals of Yangdi, and the Comprehensive Mirror agree. There is only one number for the size of the rebel force: several tens of thousands. The places taken are recorded as two district seats, Wing Prefecture and Bohai Commandery, and the individual county names are not given. The strength the government committed leaves no figure; only the rank of the commander survives, a supreme commander of the line, and the campaign ran across the turn of the year. Distances can be roughly converted using the Tang system of li: from Ye to Fuyang, the seat of Bohai Commandery in what is now the neighbourhood of Cangzhou in Hebei, is on the order of six hundred li, and to the eastern capital Luoyang on the order of four hundred and fifty. That line was the old road over which Yangdi travelled to and from Boling on his progress, and it was also the main axis for the movement of grain and troops in Hebei. The same year leaves several groups of figures in Hebei and Shandong for comparison: Zhang Jincheng of Qinghe with tens of thousands; Ge Qian of Bohai and Sun Xuanya of Shandong with one hundred thousand each; Wang Bo and Meng Rang of Shandong with more than a hundred thousand. In November the Right Commandant-General Feng Xiaoci was defeated and killed at Qinghe while fighting Zhang Jincheng, which shows how limited the fighting strength of the districts really was. The event itself preserves no figures for losses, for the number of days marched or for siege equipment. It is better to leave these blank than to invent them.
cause: 起義的直接起因在史料中沒有明文，只能從大業九年的整體局勢推。隋自大業八年冬起連續征高句麗，兵役、徭役與糧秣轉輸的負擔主要壓在山東與河北兩地；同年九月車駕北上至上谷，《隋書》記「供費不給」，當場免了太守虞荷等官，說明河北郡縣已無力供應巡行隊伍與前線大軍。六月楊玄感在黎陽起兵，關東州郡響應者數十，一度攻上東都，隨即被平；楊玄感的部眾敗後流散河北，士人與鄉里的反隋情緒因此被點燃。十月煬帝仍在北巡，閏月幸博陵，河北沿線的郡縣為迎駕、輸租而更加空虛，而負責防務的郡兵又因多年不習兵而「望風沮敗」。冬天還有另一層壓力：並汾一線的夏州稽胡貴族豆盧萼起兵，北方邊軍被牽制。鄴城一帶鄉里結社、冶鑄與漕運並存，人煙稠密、器械易得，杜彥冰與桑執行在這樣的環境中一呼而眾至數萬。至於他們首義的確切日期與最初聚集的地點，兩部史書都沒有留下記載。
causeEn: The immediate occasion of the rising is not stated in the sources and can only be inferred from the situation of the ninth year of Daye. Beginning in the winter of the eighth year the Sui had campaigned against Goguryeo in succession, and the weight of levies, of corvée labour and of transporting grain fell mainly on Shandong and Hebei. In the ninth month the imperial carriage went north to Shanggu, and the Book of Sui records that the supplies were insufficient, so that the administrator Yu He and others were dismissed on the spot; the districts of Hebei plainly could no longer provision the travelling party of the court, let alone the armies in the field. In the sixth month Yang Xuangan rose at Liyang, dozens of districts in the east answered him, and he moved on the eastern capital before being put down; the survivors of his band scattered through Hebei, and the mood of the scholars and the country people against the Sui was lit by it. In the tenth month Yangdi was still on progress, reaching Boling in the intercalary month, and the districts along his route were emptied still further to meet the carriage and transport the grain, while the county militia responsible for their defence, long unpractised in arms, lost heart at the first sign of the enemy. There was a further pressure in the winter: Doulu'e, the Jiehu chieftain of Xia Commandery on the Bing and Fen line, rose in revolt and tied down the northern frontier forces. Around Ye, village communities, smelting and river transport all existed together, the country was densely settled and metal tools were easy to come by, and in those conditions Du Yanbing and Sang Zhixing called a gathering of tens of thousands with a single shout. As for the exact day of their first rising and the spot where they first assembled, neither history records it.
impact: 杜彥冰起義本身的規模與壽命都不大，但它在河北反隋鬥爭的格局上是關鍵的一環。此後數年，河北成為隋末起義最密集的地區：竇建德在漳南起兵後盤據樂安、勢力愈強，618年建國稱夏王，自居夏王之號；清河張金稱、山東孫宣雅、渤海格謙相繼攻破郡縣；620年劉黑闥再度起兵於河北，621年才被消滅。杜彥冰的眾雖然很快潰散，卻是這條線上最早的一次大規模起事，隋廷必須在冬天的河北投入行軍總管級的兵力，也才第一次認真地以郡兵、宿衛與恩赦三線並用的辦法去收拾河北。制度層面的後果更長：地方郡兵的崩潰暴露了隋朝「兵農合一」的老底子已不可恃，隋廷越來越倚賴關隴宿衛與客觀上並不存在的「精兵」，這一取向最終通向唐初府兵制的重整與河北軍鎮的割據地理。對史家而言，本事件留下的最大遺產是文獻的空白：杜彥冰沒有傳，桑執行只有一個名字，一場在隋朝心臟地帶爆發、規模以萬計的戰爭，在正史中只佔一行字。
impactEn: The scale and the lifespan of Du Yanbing's rising were both small, yet it is a key link in the pattern of resistance in Hebei. In the years that followed, Hebei became the most crowded theatre of the late Sui revolts: Dou Jiande, having risen at Zhangnan, entrenched himself at Luan and grew steadily stronger, establishing his state in 618 and taking the title King of Xia; Zhang Jincheng of Qinghe, Sun Xuanya of Shandong and Ge Qian of Bohai in turn broke open the district cities; and in 620 Liu Heidao rose in Hebei once more, to be destroyed only in 621. Du Yanbing's host scattered quickly, but it was the earliest of these large risings, and it forced the Sui court to commit a commander of the first rank to a winter campaign in Hebei, and to try for the first time to settle Hebei by three means at once, county militia, household guard and pardon. The institutional consequences last longer. The collapse of the local militia showed that the old Sui system of soldiers and farmers together could no longer be relied upon, and the court grew ever more dependent on the guard drawn from the Guanzhong and Longxi families and on a professional quality that did not in fact exist; that drift leads in the end to the reorganization of the fubing system in the early Tang and to the geography of the military governorships in Hebei. For historians the greatest legacy of the episode is the emptiness of the record: Du Yanbing has no biography, Sang Zhixing has nothing but a name, and a war that broke out in the heartland of the Sui with tens of thousands of men occupies a single line in the official histories.
result: 結局是起義被平定。《隋書·煬帝紀》記大業九年十一月「鄴人杜彥冰、桑執行反，陷翼州、渤海郡，眾數萬」，討平記在隨後的詔令中，杜彥冰等被擒斬，眾部潰散，翼州、渤海郡一線重歸官軍控制。史書沒有留下被俘人數、降眾編制與雙方戰損的數字，因此這支部眾的下落只能記為不明。殘部有一部分散入山澤，另一部分很可能併入同年十二月在漳南起兵的竇建德以及河北其他部眾；隋廷平掉了杜彥冰，卻沒有平掉河北。到618年竇建德仍以樂安為根據地建國，621年河北的竇建德與劉黑闥兩股力量才被唐朝逐一消滅，河北的軍鎮格局自此定型。對隋朝本身而言，杜彥冰起義只是密集起義中的一環，既未單獨動搖王朝，也未能扭轉它崩解的方向——隋室在五年後的618年滅亡，真正改寫帝國的是瓦崗軍與李密，而不是鄴城這位只留下一個名字的首領。
resultEn: The outcome was that the rising was put down. The Book of Sui, Annals of Yangdi, records for the eleventh month of the ninth year of Daye that Du Yanbing and Sang Zhixing of Ye rebelled, seized Wing Prefecture and Bohai Commandery with several tens of thousands of men, and the pacification is entered under the edicts that follow: Du Yanbing and the rest were seized and beheaded, the host broke up, and the line of Wing and Bohai returned to the control of the government. The histories preserve no figure for the number taken, for the organisation of those who surrendered, or for the losses of either side, so the fate of the force can only be recorded as unknown. Part of the remnants scattered into the hills and marshes, and part was very probably absorbed into the band that Dou Jiande raised at Zhangnan in the following month and into other Hebei groupings. The Sui court put down Du Yanbing but did not put down Hebei. As late as 618 Dou Jiande was still raising a state with Luan as his base, and only in 621 were the two Hebei powers of Dou Jiande and Liu Heidao destroyed one after the other by the Tang, after which the pattern of the Hebei military governorships was fixed. For the Sui itself, Du Yanbing's rising was one link in a dense chain of risings: it did not shake the dynasty on its own, and it did not turn the direction of its collapse. The Sui house fell in 618, five years later; what rewrote the empire was the Wagang army and Li Mi, not the chief from Ye who left behind nothing but a name.
